title: Perfect Cover Letter Template
description: Structured cover letter template for international applications.
seoDescription: Copy a professional cover letter template and customize fast.
templateText:
Dear [Hiring Manager],

I am writing to apply for the [Role] position at [Company]. With [X years] of experience in [field], I have delivered [key achievement].

At [Previous Company], I [relevant impact statement]. I am confident I can contribute to [Company goal].

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
